evidence: The surface morphology was analyzed by atomic force microscopy (AFM) for the films as-deposited at 225 °C, and annealed (RTA) at 600, 800, and 1000 °C for 15 s. The root mean square (rms) values for the film surface were 0.171, 0.448, 0.456, and 0.367 nm, respectively. The roughness of the film with Hf 0.68Al0.32Ox increased with increasing annealing temperature. However, after RTA at 1000 °C, the roughness was abruptly decreased due to the change in the crystal structure (Fig. 2).
